newsitem.title: USA: Dow, Nasdaq higher, but trading seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Dow, Nasdaq higher, but trading seen mixed.

text.p: U.S. blue chips and the Nasdaq composite were higher in morning trade on Thursday, but market-watchers said trading was mixed and hard to predict even as a rebound in some technology stocks lent support.

The Dow Jones industrial average was up 21 points or 0.30 percent at 7291, after closing lower on Wednesday. Nasdaq was up 0.51 percent or around seven points at 1387, as many of the larger-capitalization technology issues trended higher.
But investors were cautious ahead of a key U.S. unemployment report on Friday, and wary that companies would make negative earnings preannouncements as the quarter closed.
